gloss: wheat gluten; fu (dried or fresh gluten cake)

definitions.gloss: wheat gluten; fu (dried or fresh gluten cake)
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese food made from wheat gluten, available in dried or fresh forms and used in soups, stews, and other dishes.

notes:
A traditional Japanese ingredient made by washing wheat flour dough to extract the gluten. Comes in two main forms: ⟦{焼|や}き{麩|ふ}→焼き麩：23650_yakifu⟧ (baked and dried fu) and ⟦{生麩|なまふ}→生麩：23651_namafu⟧ (fresh fu).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{麩|ふ}→焼き麩：23650_yakifu⟧: baked/dried fu — the most common type, light and spongy
- ⟦{生麩|なまふ}→生麩：23651_namafu⟧: fresh fu — a Kyoto specialty with a soft, mochi-like texture
- ⟦{車麩|くるまふ}→車麩：08113_kurumafu⟧: wheel-shaped fu — a large ring-shaped dried fu, specialty of Niigata
- {麩|ふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup with fu
- {麩菓子|ふがし}: fu snack — a sweet snack made from baked fu coated in brown sugar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グルテン: gluten — the loanword, used in scientific or Western food contexts
- ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧: tofu — also a protein-rich traditional food, but made from soybeans rather than wheat

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fu has been a staple of Japanese Buddhist vegetarian cuisine (⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧) for centuries. ⟦{生麩|なまふ}→生麩：23651_namafu⟧ from Kyoto is considered a delicacy and is often shaped into decorative forms for use in traditional ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧ cuisine.
